text:
maria: Quick thought — we need a compact 'decision snapshot' card in Rollouts for autofallbacks. Right now postmortems dig through logs to figure out which signal flipped and why.

sanjay: +1. can we make it a single row per decision: trigger, selected mode, percent, selected fallback, and why (signal + metric window)?

dom: agree. also we should surface whether the decision was automated or operator-approved. e.g. auto vs manual override.

kevin: UX question — do we store a full immutable snapshot at the moment of switch, or reconstruct from telemetry later? storing snapshot = storage cost but simpler for audits.

ux: We chatted about this in design sync. preference is a lightweight snapshot + link to raw traces. snapshot should contain: policy id, policy revision, trigger expression, evaluated values, chosen action, confidence score, decision_ts, and actor (bot or user).

maria: Minimal example card we imagine:

- policy: rollout-2026-05-3 (rev: 7)
- triggered_by: latency_p95 > 800ms (window=60s)
- observed: latency_p95=920ms
- action: soft_degrade -> 15% -> model:redwood-gpt-7b-q4
- actor: auto-fallback-service
- audit_ref: link to trace

sanjay: We should include the raw evaluated clause so compliance can replay: e.g.

```
policy_clause: "(p95_latency > 800 && error_rate < 0.05) || capacity_surge"
evaluated:
  p95_latency: 920
  error_rate: 0.012
  capacity_surge: false
```

dom: How about retention? Compliance wants these for 90 days at least. Ops wants sampling after 30 days — keep full for critical customers only.

kevin: Suggestion: store full snapshots for customers with enterprise contracts (SLA tag), for others keep aggregated traces + a 1-line decision summary. We already tag requests by account tier in telemetry.

maria: Another API debate: should policy snapshots be emitted by the policy engine as JSON events to the audit stream, or should console reconstruct via /policy/evaluate endpoints? I prefer engine-emitted events (single source of truth).

sanjay: Emitted events are better for fidelity. If we do that we need an idempotent schema: event_id, policy_id, revision, timestamp, evaluated_values, action, actor, links[].

ux: UI mockups look better if we can show a mini timeline: pre-signal trend + point of action + immediate after-effects (latency/error trend). That requires linking the snapshot to a telemetry query ID.

audit-bot: NOTE: if we emit snapshots we must include a signature (HMAC) for the event payload so downstream archives can verify integrity. Compliance requires tamper-evidence.

dom: Good call. also we need to think about retention encryption (SSE-KMS) for enterprise buckets.

kevin: Small implementation sketch (policy engine emits):

```
{
  "event_id":"evt_2799123456_01",
  "policy_id":"rollout-2026-05-3",
  "revision":7,
  "timestamp":"2026-03-04T15:03:12Z",
  "evaluated":{...},
  "action":{"type":"soft_degrade","percent":15,"fallback":"redwood-gpt-7b-q4"},
  "actor":"auto-fallback-service",
  "trace_link":"/traces/xyz",
  "signature":"hmac:..."
}
```

maria: UX asks — can we make the audit card actionable? e.g., a quick rollback button (if manual) or a 'explain' drawer that shows which clause contributed most to the score.

ux: yes, 'explain' should show ranked contribution: feature -> delta_score. keep it lightweight for the first iteration.

sanjay: Also need to show if the fallback was a full model swap or a routing percentage change. Those have different downstream impacts.

dom: Ops concern: noise. we will get tons of tiny autoswitches. we should bucket similar decisions (same policy, same action within X mins) into a single group for the console timeline.

kevin: Agreed, group by policy_id + action_signature within a 5m window. keep group representative snapshot but preserve originals in the audit store.

maria: One more thing — sampling for non-enterprise customers: store full snapshot in S3 for 7 days, then compress to aggregated records. Enterprise: full retention per contract + encrypted.

ux: For the UI copy: 'Decision snapshot — captured at time of switch. Use "Explain" to inspect contributing signals. This record is retained per your account policy.'

audit-bot: ACTION: security to add HMAC header to policy events. storage team to provide retention tier mapping. ux to prototype the card (small timeline + explain + rollback CTA).

maria: Thanks — I'll spin a tiny PR that adds the event payload schema and a sample emitted event. posting a link to the PR shortly.

sanjay: thx — ping when PR is up, i'll review the schema for edge cases (nan, missing fields, partial evaluates).

kevin: I'll prototype grouping logic in the policy service and emit a sample set to the dev telemetry sandbox.

dom: Reopening existing incident logs might be useful to validate the explain data — let's run a backfill for last 48h in staging.

maria: plan looks good. keeping this thread as the spec until PR lands. :thumbsup:
